description: §5.2 rule 2, S457 bullet `srcdoc` in every form: an `<each>` row's `srcdoc=pg.html` writes row data into an HTML document and is refused.
rationale: §5.2 rule 2 (S457): a `srcdoc` whose value is a variable (`srcdoc=it.html`) SHALL be a compile error (E-ATTR-INTERP-EXECUTABLE) in every position rule 2 names, `<each>` rows included. Before S457 the row lowering emitted `setAttribute("srcdoc", String(pg.html))`.
